notes: «أن سلمة، بن الأكوع قال» links Salama as the source Abd al-Rahman had it from (rule 5); the comma is in the stored text and kept
«ونسبه غير ابن وهب فقال ابن عبد الله بن كعب بن مالك» gives another lineage for the same Abd al-Rahman: a gloss, left out, not a second person
Second isnad for the same story (Ibn Shihab asks Salama's son, who relates from his father with changed wording): its own group; the son is unnamed in the text
